title: Editing a no-charge line's hours keeps its mark
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, whose line 2 of 1.0 hour is No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Change line 2's hours to 2.0 with Edit Labor.
  3. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Line 2 shows "No Charge · Goodwill".

Step 2:

  • The hours read 2.0.

Step 3:

  • Line 2 still shows "No Charge · Goodwill" and $0.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R1: “On a billable work order, while the setting is on and the work order is not invoiced, the three-dots menu of every line offers "Mark as No Charge" between Edit line and Delete line. Edit Line and New Line show at the bottom, under a divider, the checkbox "No Charge" with the helper "This line shows $0.00 on the invoice. Hours and parts stay; the parts cost posts to the category's expense account." and, when ticked, the selects Category *, Original work order and Original line of S2-R2, so a line can be created No Charge. Both doors write the same fields. Lines the Line Builder creates (it has no dialog) are marked afterwards from the line menu.”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan line 1075 (TP-107): “Edit Labor / inline save / ShopCoach never clearing a line mark (D57)”
  • Tech plan line 1503 (TP-162): “After the reload, the chip and the $0.00 rate remain”
  • Tech plan line 2653 (TP-289): “**An absent block means unchanged** (Edit Labor, inline save and ShopCoach never clear a mark).”
